description: EIA - Coal Data Browser is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The U.S. coal data are collected and prepared for release by the Office of Oil, Gas, and Coal Supply Statistics, U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA). The data are compiled from the following EIA survey source: Form EIA-7A, "Coal Production and Preparation Report" and the U.S. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Coal. Its keywords are coal mines, coal mines and mining, coal fields. The portal shows 2026-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
